task: Investigate the C_LOC warning/error logs without changing production physics or samples

status.C_LOC: Integration completed; event generation interrupted by user (KeyboardInterrupt), 22 completed generation jobs out of 103. No combined events file, no shower yet.
status.C_GLB: One million events generated; comparison covers integration and generation logs only.

conclusion: Confirmed floating-point bugs in phase-space geometry and soft-sector angular factors; further ill-conditioned native maps. These are integration diagnostics before Pythia, and whole folded points are discarded. Production accuracy is not established by their rejection frequency.

azimuth_lost_near_beam.mechanism: getangles sets sin(theta)=0 and phi=0 when pz/|p| rounds to +1 even though pT is nonzero; inverse and forward frames then disagree.
azimuth_lost_near_beam.candidate: Use atan2(pT,pz), sin(theta)=pT/|p| and the actual transverse azimuth for every nonzero pT; retain exact zero-axis convention.
azimuth_lost_near_beam.tolerance: Original reconstruction tolerance 1e-4; candidate max relative error 9.270576957188422e-10.

nonfinite_soft_G_weight.mechanism: Near the top-at-rest limit, sqrt(1-(mt/E)^2) loses precision or has a negative argument because a stored counterevent top energy is a few 1e-12 GeV below mt. NaN enters fks_Sij, then the type-8 soft G replacement. This is not a zero prefactor multiplying an irrelevant NaN.
nonfinite_soft_G_weight.candidate: Use spatial momenta explicitly transformed to the relevant CM frame for velocities and angular dot products; validate threshold limits rather than clamping a negative square-root argument.
nonfinite_soft_G_weight.scope: One full-physics replay confirms the mechanism, not the rate impact or that all nonfinite weights share it.

remaining_light_FSR_ISR.mechanism: Near-collinear dipoles with both inverse coordinates close to their boundaries amplify tiny off-shell/conservation errors already present in the double-precision outer vectors. In a light-FSR example E+pz has about 8% relative error although the energy error is O(1e-11 GeV).
remaining_light_FSR_ISR.high_precision_probe: Quadruple-precision inverse/forward still fails on the stored off-shell vector; restoring on-shell final energies and consistent incoming light-cone sums in the isolated high-precision fixture makes the example pass.
remaining_light_FSR_ISR.required_work: Stabilize on-shell/light-cone arithmetic consistently in outer generation and native replay, including counterevent endpoint comparisons and invariant-mass checks; validate all histories.
remaining_light_FSR_ISR.status: Concrete light-FSR example diagnosed; no general production fix or bias estimate claimed.

generic_messages.maxjetflavor: Run-card value 4 is automatically replaced by 5 for the massless-bottom model; also happens in the global sample.
generic_messages.OneLOop: Rare all-zero c0 and d0 permutation diagnostics occur in both global and local runs; they are separate from the dominant local reconstruction problem and not demonstrated harmless for every point.
generic_messages.555555: Summary of failed counterevent momentum comparisons, not a fatal exit code.
generic_messages.fatal_termination: The final run error is the user KeyboardInterrupt, not a Pythia crash.

recommended_next_steps: Promote the validated stable-angle candidate to a proper regression-tested fix.
Implement and validate stable CM velocity/angular evaluation for the soft sector factors.
Repair the remaining endpoint/on-shell/light-cone reconstruction failures, keeping complete S/H sums and meaningful validity checks.
Repeat a controlled local integration and inclusive closure comparison with the fixes before restarting local production; assess weighted shifts and shapes, not just rejection counts.
Record the affected helper/radiation/sector-function sources in campaign provenance when deploying the physics fixes.
